articleBlocks: I stared at this grid for a while, seeing only a random collection of nouns.
My first thought was maybe this had something to do with tattoo aftercare, since 'Pad' and 'Stain' could fit the healing process.
But 'Jet' didn't fit that theory at all, so I had to rethink my angle.
Then, I considered if it was about items in a doctor's office, but that also fell apart quickly.
The clue 'Jet' made me think of ink jet printers.
That's when I realized all the clues could come *after* the word 'ink'.
Suddenly, 'Well', 'Pad', 'Stain', and 'Blot' all clicked into place: Ink Well, Ink Pad, Ink Stain, and Ink Blot.
The answer is 'Words that come after ink'.
The trick was realizing that the clues needed a word *before* them to make sense together.
Now, I'll be sure to consider prefixes and suffixes when I'm stuck on a word puzzle.
